<div class="card-body">
'''Sandcrawler''' is a [[Light]] [[Vehicle]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">サンドクローラー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">８名までの乗客を運べる。タトゥイーンの位置カードに配備せねばならない。惑星の位置カードにしか移動できない。屋外の位置カードにいる場合、そこにいるジャワは没収値が＋１される。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-150o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">家畜小屋のような密閉型住居運搬用ビークル。タトゥイーンの略奪者から身を守る。元来は鉱物採掘車であり、鉱床閉鎖に伴い、ジャワ族が手に入れた。二つと同じ物はない。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Sandcrawler.

'''Card text:''' May carry up to eight passengers. Must deploy at a Tatooine site. May move only to planetary sites. At an exterior site, Jawas there are forfeit +1.

'''Lore:''' An enclosed vehicle for carrying living quarters, rather like a livestock shed. It protects against Tatooine raiders. Originally mining vehicles, they were acquired by Jawas when the mines closed. No two are alike.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Sandcrawler]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
